email-recovery-busy: Cili walima makɔnɔsɛbɛn ka baara wɛrɛ bɛ ka kɛ. A lakuraya, a lajɛ kokura waati dɔɔnin kɔfɛ.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: I bɛ cikanw bɛɛ dabila minnu bɛ makɔnɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ sisan sɔrɔbaga in ye wa? U kɔnɔkow bɛna bɔ, u tɛ se ka lasegin. Cikan kuraw minnu dilanna delili in kɔfɛ bɛna mara.
email-recovery-description: Sira kelen cikan sɔrɔbaga kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye. Ɲini baarakɛla ka ID fɛ. Cikanw kɔnɔkow ani sɔrɔbaga ka imɛli yɔrɔw tɛ jira. Lajɔli waati dɔ kɔnɔ bɛ cikanw minnu bɛ yen ani minnu bɛna na minɛ; cili ta tuguni bɛ cikanw minnu bɛ makɔnɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ ci lajɛ kokura sisan. Dabilali bɛ cikanw bɔ minnu donna makɔnɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ fo delili waati. Ni cikan ci bɛ ka kɛ, a lajɛ kokura waati dɔɔnin kɔfɛ. Cikan min ci daminɛna, o tɛ se ka lasegin, ani cikan min ka ci nɔfɛko ma dafa, o bɛ se ka ci siɲɛ fila. Filiw minnu bɛ to yen ani cikanw minnu sera lajɛli hakɛ dan na bɛ mara sɛgɛsɛgɛli kama. Cikanw minnu ci ma ɲɛ lajɛli kokura bɛ lajɛli kura daminɛ, wa a bɛ lajɔli waati dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ yen mara.
email-recovery-empty: Cikan si tɛ makɔnɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ, sɔrɔbaga si fana tɛ yen min ka cili lajɔra waati dɔ kɔnɔ.
email-recovery-failed: Baara ma se ka dafalenya. Makɔnɔsɛbɛn lakuraya, ni a mago bɛ, baara kelen in lajɛ kokura.
email-recovery-pending: A bɛ makɔnɔ walima a bɛ lajɛ kokura
email-recovery-retry: Cikanw minnu ci ma ɲɛ lajɛ kokura
email-recovery-superseded: Baarakɛla ka baara kura ye delili in nɔ ta. Makɔnɔsɛbɛn sisan cogo bɛ jira.
email-recovery-unavailable: Imɛli makɔnɔsɛbɛn tɛ se ka kalan. Ɲɛmɔgɔ ka donni yamaruya lajɛ ani sɛrɛwɛri bɛ se ka baara kɛ wa.
